about_the_game:
The official soundtrack of Neon Blood captures the vast cyberpunk world of Viridis. The combination of synthesizers and ambient themes will put you in the shoes of Axel McCoin and his journey to unravel the secrets of Blind CIty.

The official soundtrack of Neon Blood has been produced and composed by WIld Cat Records.
